objective: exploratory cross-paper, unseen-edit-group prediction of hemolysis percentage under reported dose; test utility of monotonic dose constraint

datasets.confirmed_overlay_primary: reuse confirmed_non_point_exclusion_panels.json; 284 metadata panels with >=3 distinct positive molar doses; 1305 points. No filter by response span, monotonicity or model outcomes
datasets.all_exact50_quarantine_sensitivity: reuse all_exact50_quarantine_panels.json; 253 panels >=3 doses, 1208 points. Response-dependent conservative exclusion; not asserted clean or representative

measurement_policy: original database untouched. Inherited confirmed exclusions: raw11995 reportedHC50-derived not direct point;12005/12025 wrongSI columns;D-type12015 already outside scope. Other percent literals remain unverified-source candidates, exact50 flagged rather than labeled wrong
panel_key: sequence + chemical form + PMID + reported RBC species + reported pH; unknown pH does not establish same actual conditions
split: 5 folds by entire PMID, greedy descending primary-panel count then numeric PMID tie; assign lowest panel-load fold (index tie). Reuse this mapping for sensitivity. Purge any training panel whose existing unit-edit20percent transitive group appears in test. Train/test use entire panels, no dose-point random split
training_scope: only >=3-dose eligible metadata panels in each dataset; no samples added or dropped on the basis of outcome pattern
features: fixed previous sequence composition20 + dipeptide400 + length/charge density/meanKD/ideal helix hydrophobic moment + explicit C-amide/N-acetyl + reported RBC one-hot + log10 positive dose_uM. No target/HC50/SI/PMID/panel_id/name/SMILES/heldout predictions as inputs

models.unconstrained: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor squared_error; all monotonic constraints zero
models.monotonic_dose: identical model and feature matrix; log10dose monotonic_cst=+1, all other constraints zero

weights: each training panel total weight1 before normalizing average row weight to1; test primary MAE equal weight per panel
prediction: clip both models to [0,100]; numeric outputs are exploratory estimates, no deployable model or HC50 extrapolation
metrics: decreasing predicted adjacent steps and 64point log-dose grid violations
mean predicted and observed panel response spans
reference: training-panel-weighted median constant, fitted only on training fold; no new baseline hyperparameter search
uncertainty: 2000 paired bootstrap of retained sequence edit groups, sum equal-panel loss difference / panel count; report positive MAE reduction for monotonic benefit, plus per-fold differences. Secondary paper-cluster CI. Fixed OOF predictions only, no retraining uncertainty
continue_gate: for this exploratory screen only: primary paired-group MAE-reduction CI lower>0 and >=4/5 fold MAE improvements; sensitivity effect same direction; incremental-response MAE not worse. Gate failure means do not upscale network or search new hyperparameters on these results
limitations: previously examined observational data, not new blind validation
PMID identifiers may include indirect sources
unreported assay conditions and incomplete original-measurement provenance
retained exact50 records may still mix derived endpoints; sensitivity is also selected on response value
sequence edit groups are not certified biological families
nondecreasing response is a candidate prior within reported conditions, not a universal biological mechanism
monotonic boosting is established, not neural-network novelty by itself
